# Cake baker

Sweet Almond Bakery, who would make the wedding cake.

- Tasting: booked for 9 November at 11 am.
- Gluten-free sponge layers are possible; they bake them in a separate tin.
- Flavours: lemon and elderflower, dark chocolate, carrot with cream cheese.
- Deposit: 80 pounds, due on booking.
